senses.gloss: f. pl.(b. h.; denom. of ראשׁ)head-part of the bed, bolster, pillow.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5:16">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>תולה …</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>מ׳ המטה</he> he may suspend them from the head-board of the bed, opp. <cite ref="M02519"><he>מרגלות</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 78a:10">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>מניחה תחת מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו</he> put it under his bolster.

<cite ref="Shabbat 12b:3">Sabb. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שכינה למעלה מראשותיו של</he> (= <he>ממ׳</he>) <cite ref="H00333"><he>חולה</he></cite> the Divine Presence is above the head-side of the patient; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 741:2">Yalk. Ps. 741</cite>.
